verses.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.sm: Asafo e aʻoaʻo ai. Lo'u nuu e, ia outou faalogologo mai i laʻu tulafono;

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.sm: ia uai mai o outou taliga i upu a loʻu gutu. Ou te tautala atu lava i le faataoto;

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.sm: ou te taʻu atu mea lilo talu anamua, o mea na tatou faalogologo i ai, ma tatou iloa;

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.sm: na talaina mai foi ia te i tatou e o tatou tama. Tatou te le natia ia mea i a latou fanau, a e ta‘uta‘u atu i tupulaga amuli o viiga o le ALII, ma lona malosi, ma ona Vavega na na faia.

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.sm: Ua ia faatuina le tulafono ia Iakopo, ua ja tuuina foi le poloaiga ia Isaraelu, o mea naja poloai atu ai i o tatou tama, ina ia latou faailoa ai i a latou fanau; ina ja iloa ai e le tupulaga amuli,

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.sm: o fenau lava e fanau mai; e tutupu mai i latou, ma taʻu atu ai i a latou fanau, ina ja fai le Atua mo latou faatuatuaga; ma ja le galo galuega a le Atua;

verses.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.sm: a ja latou tausi i ana poloaiga; ina ja le pei o latou tama i latou, o le tupulaga vaogata ma le fouvale;

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.sm: na le mafafai foi ona latou savavali i lana tulafono; na latou faagalogaloina foi ana galuega,

verses.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.sm: ua faapea a latou, Ua mafaia ea e le Atua ona laulau mai mea e ‘ai i le vao?

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.en: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.sm: O le mea lea na faafofoga mai ai le ALII, ona toasa mai ai lea o ia; na tutu ai le afi ia lakopo, na oo ae foi le toatamai ia Isaraelu;

verses.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.sm: aua ua latou le faatuatua i le Atua, ua latou le faalagolago i le olataga mai ia te ia.

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

verses.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.sm: na faaumatia foi o latou tausaga i le atuatuvale. Na latou sailiili atu ia te ia ina o fasiotia i latou e ia;

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.sm: ona latou foi ai lea i le sailiili i latou i le Atua. Ona latou manatu ifo ai lea o le Atua o lo latou papa ia;

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.sm: o le Atua silisili o ia na te faaolaina i latou. A ua latou pepelo ia te ia i o latou gutu,

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.sm: ma va latou faa“ole“ole ia te ia i o latou laulaufaiva. E lei tutumau foi o latou loto ia te ia, e lei faamaoni foi latou i lana feagaiga.

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.sm: A oja, ua alofa mutimuti vale, ua ia faamagaloina a latou amio leaga; na ie. le faaumatia ai i latou; ua liliv ese faalasi e ia lona toasa,

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.sm: tou faaonoono ia te ia i le vao; na latou faalili lava ia te ia i le vao.

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.sm: Na latou toe tofotofo lava i le Atua; ma latou faaonoono i le Paia o Isaraelu. Latou te lei manatua lona aa0,

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.sm: atoa ma ona vavega i le laueleele o Soana. Na ia liua foi o latou vaitafe ma toto, atoa ma o latou vaita'i, ina ia latou le inu ai.

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.sm: Na ia aauina atu ia te i latou o garova, na ‘aina ai i latou; o rane foi na faaumatia ai i latou.

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.sm: Na ia avatua foi o fua o lo latou fanua i le se kasili,

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.sm: na avatua foi a latou galuega i le se akerise. Na ia faamateina o a latou vine i le uato‘a,

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.sm: na ia faamateina foi a latou sukamoru i le uato“a tetele. Na ia tuuina atu foi o a latou manu i le uato‘a ma na tuuina a latou lafu mamoe i le uila.

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.sm: Na ia faaoo ia te i latou o lona toasa mamafa, o le ma“ema'ea, le toatamai, ma le puapuaga, i lona aauina atu o auauna e i ai mala. Ua na saunia le ala o lona toasa; e lei faasaoina e ia o i latou i le ou, a ua tuuina atu o latou ola i le faamai; na ia fasia foi ulumatua uma i Aikupito; o le amataga o lo latou malosi na i fale ie o Hamo. Na ia aumaia foi lona nuu e pei o mamoe, ma na tafita‘iina i latou i le vao e pei o se lafu. Na ia ta‘ita‘iina i latou ua saogalemu, o lea na le fefefe ai i latou; a o e ua ita i ai, ua lofia i latou i le sami. Na ia faaoo ia te i latou i lona laueleele paia, o lenei lava mauga na ia maua i lona aao taumatau. Na ia tulia foi nuu ese i o latou luma, ona vaevaeina atu lea e ia ia te i latou le tofi ua fuatia, ma na faanonofo o itu aiga o Isaraelu i o latou fale ie. A ua latou tofotofo ma faaonoono i le Atua silisili ese; e lei tausi foi e i latou ana tulafono. Ua toe liliu i latou, ma faa‘ole‘ole e pei o latou tama; ua liua i latou e pei o le aufana ua pepelo. Na latou faalili foi ia te ia i a latou mea maualuluga; na latou faatupuina foi lona fua i a latou tupua ua ta. Ua faafofoga le Atua, ona toasa tele ai lea o ia, ona matua ʻinoʻino ai lea o ia ia Isaraelu; na ia lafoai ai le malumalu i Sailo, o le fale fetafai sa mau ai o ia ma tagata. Na ia tuuina atu foi lona malosi ia tafea, na ia tuuina atu foi lona matagofie i le lima o le ua ita mai. Na ia tuuina foi o lona nuu i le pelu, ma ua toasa tele ia i lona lava tofi. O latou taulelea ua faaumatia i le afi; o latou taupou foi ua le viia i latou. O latou faitaulaga, ua oti i latou i le pelu; e lei taufaiaue foi a latou avà. Ona maleifua ai lea o le ALII e peiseai na tofa, e pei o se tagata malosi ua alaga ona o le uaina. Ua na taia e ua ita ia te ia i o latou tua; ua na faia lea mo latou luma e faavavau. Na ia tetee atu foi i le fale ie o Josefa, na ia le filifilia foi le itu aiga o Efaraima. A ua ia filifilia le itu aiga o luta, o le mauga o Siona na ia finagalo i ai.

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

verses.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

verses.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
